summary: The note describes The Handmaid's Tale, an American television series created by Bruce Miller and streamed on Hulu, adapted from Margaret Atwood's 1985 novel. It presents the dystopian premise of Gilead, a totalitarian theonomic regime in the former United States where fertile women called Handmaids are forced into sexual servitude. It follows Offred, assigned to the Waterford household, and notes the series' premiere, renewal, and major awards including Emmys and Golden Globes.
one_line: American Hulu dystopian drama created by Bruce Miller, adapted from Margaret Atwood's 1985 novel about Gilead's enslaved Handmaids.
key_facts: The Handmaid's Tale is an American television series created by Bruce Miller based on the 1985 novel of the same name by Canadian writer Margaret Atwood.
Streaming service Hulu ordered The Handmaid's Tale as a straight-to-series order of 10 episodes, with production beginning in late 2016.
The series premiered on Hulu on April 26, 2017, with the first three episodes.
The subsequent seven episodes aired on a weekly basis every Wednesday.
In May 2017, The Handmaid's Tale was renewed for a second season scheduled to premiere on April 25, 2018.
The series is set in Gilead, a totalitarian, Christian theonomic government that establishes rule in the former United States after a Second American Civil War.
Handmaids are fertile women conscripted by Gilead and assigned to the homes of the ruling elite, where they must submit to ritualized rape to bear children.
June Osborne, renamed Offred, is played by Elisabeth Moss and is assigned to Commander Fred Waterford (Joseph Fiennes) and his wife Serena Joy (Yvonne Strahovski).
Women in Gilead are by law not allowed to work, own property, handle money, or read.
The Handmaid's Tale won eight Primetime Emmy Awards from 13 nominations, including Outstanding Drama Series.
It became the first series on a streaming platform to win an Emmy for Outstanding Series.
The series won Golden Globe Awards for Best Television Series - Drama and Best Actress for Elisabeth Moss.
Production locations listed include Toronto, Hamilton, Cambridge and Vaughan in Ontario.
The show's composer is listed as Adam Taylor, and its original network is Hulu.
